about: P3's kernel census on the laptop's Arch, one untimed job (paper/laptop_w/census_host.py at e886724). Read-only on the host; about a minute.

jobs.run_label: P3's kernel census on Arch (untimed, descriptive, decides nothing): the gated October Release oneport started with no client and no load in five layouts (epoll one-port, dedicated, SO_REUSEPORT with two workers; io_uring one-port, dedicated); ss -Hltnp counts its listening sockets, checked against /proc/net/tcp
jobs.note: read-only on the host: builds nothing, installs nothing, changes no setting, no package manager; the binary is the October measured build that lab/gates/gate-L.json (sha256 c6517177) names, oneport 4c64edc2, at the path the census of 2026-10-22 used; the collector refuses (exit 2) if the gate or the binary is missing or differs, and exits 3 if a row fails; expected_s: no measured basis on the laptop (the desktop's functional run of the Windows rows took 1.2 s for two rows); timeout_s: the collector's own caps give at most 251 s (five rows, each at most 15 s to its ready line, 0.2 s settle, 20 s for ss, 10 s to stop and 5 s to kill); the io_uring check stays on (two rows use io_uring)
jobs.plain: Ask Arch's kernel how many listening sockets P3's measured server opens in each layout, with no traffic
